title: Assign an appliance engineer after landlord approval

semantic_requirements.description: The trade is relevant to appliance/dishwasher repair, not an unrelated trade such as gardening.
The notes limit the work to dishwasher inspection and the existing approval scope, without authorizing arbitrary purchases or spending.
The reason cites the approval in events 009/010.

prohibited_behaviors: Claiming an appointment time, completed repairs, or payment before assigning a contractor.
Requesting exactly the same approval again without explaining a new reason.

input_evidence.excerpt:
Address: Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 1ZZ

Good afternoon Turner,

I have had a report from the tenants regarding the dishwasher having some issues. At the moment it doesn't complete a cycle.

Would you be happy for me to get a contractor out to have a look at this for you.

Please let me know your thoughts on this.

Kind regards

Clarke

Yes please go ahead.

Thank you!

Sent from my iPhone
Landlord approval confirmed. Proceed to provider selection.

provenance.derivation: Historical event 004 requests an inspection; the landlord says go ahead in 009; 010 records approval; the next event, 011, is Maintenance provider assigned. assign_contractor accepts trade/notes, not a specific provider, so the agent is not required to guess Oakfield Homes, which first appears in future event 012.
provenance.review_scope: Historical prefix events 001–010 and the reference action; later events are not inputs or required facts.

grading.action_source: Use recorded CaseState.actions or tool entries in traces, not only model statements or the status in ANSWER.md.
grading.rule: The run may take several actions. A successful action must match an allowed branch (name and exact_arguments); the run must end on that action, or on hold or escalate after it (close_case only when it is the matched branch); no guard may refuse an action. Sum semantic_requirements weights over the matched action and normalize to a score from 0 to 4. A prohibited behavior in any action of the run yields 0. History is not the only acceptable answer; alternative paths may be retained for manual review.
grading.tool_error: A failed/refused tool is not successful execution. Record the failure; do not manually fix the answer.
grading.semantic_review: Assess message/argument semantics against the visible input and labels. Do not treat new facts in future reference_actions as facts already known to the agent.
